About me

Design-minded developer, pursuing a B.E. in Computer Science & Design.

I'm Manoharan Ramakrishnan, a final-year B.E. Computer Science & Design student at Kongu Engineering College. My field combines technology, creativity, and problem-solving, which aligns perfectly with my passion for building meaningful digital products.

I work across the stack, using React.js and Figma for frontend development and user experience design, while leveraging Java and Node.js for backend development. I also work with MySQL and MongoDB to build reliable and data-driven applications. I enjoy creating projects that solve real-world problems and deliver intuitive experiences for users.

Outside academics, I'm an NSS Volunteer and continuously expand my skills through hands-on projects, certifications, and self-learning. My goal is to grow as a Full Stack Developer and UI/UX Designer, building scalable, user-centered solutions that make a real impact.

Full Stack · Theater Booking

BookMyShowTime

A web-based theater booking system that takes someone from choosing a movie to a confirmed seat, snack order, and saved profile — with an admin side to manage it all.

  • Seat selection and snack pre-ordering in one booking flow
  • Admin panel for managing movies, schedules, and customer queries
  • User profiles and payment simulation for an end-to-end experience
